headline: Federal Reserve Expected to Hold Rates Amid Sticky Inflation
summary: The Federal Reserve is widely expected to hold interest rates steady as inflation moves in the wrong direction while the labor market remains stable.
why: Federal Reserve monetary policy decisions dictate global borrowing costs, currency valuations, and equity market liquidity.

impacts.name: US Banking and Financial Markets
impacts.why: Pausing interest rate cuts while inflation remains elevated keeps borrowing costs high for corporations and consumers.

why_moved: Expectations of unchanged interest rates amid persistent inflation alter fixed-income yields and reprice risk assets.
